correctness.rationale: Multinomial-square identity is derived from two Vandermonde convolutions. Multinomial Lucas gives the five-digit sign rule; exact carry coefficients are (5,0),(0,1),(-1,2),(2,-1),(1,0). The \(5^{-r}\) decay, all-shift limits, equality classification, logarithmic index-discrepancy, and exact adjacent table are fully proved. Independent original-sum checks for 210 terms, 384 finite-block sums, 24 adjacent pair cells, and 100000 shift extrema passed; finite computations are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The classical Domb sequence has an intrinsic combinatorial and number-theoretic role. Its modulo-five quadratic sign has an exceptional one-negative-digit product, giving a natural pair-frequency invariant; the exact four-cell adjacent count, \(O_h(\log N)\) asymptotic, and unique maximally agreeing/disagreeing shifts are information not implied by marginal residue counts. They are not an arbitrary finite computation or a mere restatement of Lucas congruence.
